content:
From today, iPhone users who have installed the Suno app can generate songs within the Messages app via text or voice prompts. Details are as follows.

Suno brings AI song generation to iMessage

Suno is one of the most popular AI song generation platforms, with over 2 million paying subscribers and 7 million songs generated daily.

In addition to its web platform, Suno also has an iPhone app that lets users create and remix AI songs through text, recordings, or uploaded audio and video. It also features collections of user-created songs, curated edits, and playlists sorted by genre.

Now, Suno users can also create songs directly within Apple's Messages app. Once the Suno app is installed, it will appear in the Messages app's app drawer alongside other iMessage apps, allowing users to generate songs via text prompts or voice messages without leaving the conversation.

Here's a live demo of the feature in action:

Suno says users can pick a genre before generating a song, and can also regenerate multiple versions so they can find a favourite before sending it in the chat.

One potential limitation is that, according to Suno, both parties need to have the app installed to use the feature. However, for users who enjoy AI song creation, downloading the free app shouldn't be too big a hurdle.

Download Suno on the App Store.
